description: Declarative Infrastructure-as-Code & configuration for CachyOS (Niri Wayland) Workstation

subsystems.name: Niri Wayland Compositor
subsystems.summary: Scrollable-tiling Wayland compositor with modular KDL configs in niri/.config/niri/cfg/

subsystems.name: Personal AI Stack & Memory
subsystems.summary: Ollama (:11434, 16GB vRAM budget), Khoj AI (:42110, pgvector :5432), Headroom Proxy (:8787), AnythingLLM Desktop, OpenCommit

subsystems.name: Ansible Orchestration
subsystems.summary: Single source of truth for packages (playbooks/vars/packages.yml); modular system, user, ai_stack playbooks

subsystems.name: Development Toolchains & Runtimes
subsystems.summary: Mise version manager, Rust (mold, sccache, cargo-binstall), Node/TS (bun, pnpm, biome), Python (uv)

subsystems.name: Terminal & Shell UX Flow
subsystems.summary: Modal UX: Ghostty, Zsh Vi-mode, Neovim (v), fzf-tab, zoxide, television, superfile; all scripts in zsh/.zsh/scripts/

core_rules: SSOT for all packages is playbooks/vars/packages.yml. Never invoke pacman/paru directly in tasks.
Custom shell scripts and helpers MUST be placed in zsh/.zsh/scripts/ (auto-exported to PATH via .zshenv).
AUR packages (paru) must NEVER be run as root.
vRAM budget is strict (16 GB): only 1 model active in Ollama at a time (OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=1).
Long-term memory is explicit tool calls only (no implicit prompt injection / context poisoning).
